properties.state: {"description":"Two gap detectors, the third leg of the root-cause vocabulary (dec:idea-how-does-root-cause-become-automatic-rule-hook-detector-or-composition, mechanism (c)). `fix_without_recorded_cause`: one aggregate finding over every ChangeEvent of change_type defect_fix or test_failure_fix that sits on no CAUSES edge in either direction and carries no outgoing INVALIDATES — a repair indistinguishable from a symptom fix. A CAUSES edge on an artifact the fix touched is deliberately not counted. Forward-only by parking: a fix GOVERNED_BY ruling=parks under an accepted Decision is skipped and counted. `defect_overtaken_by_change`: one finding per open defect TemporalFact (no valid_to, no incoming INVALIDATES) whose subject_id, or an Artifact that REALIZES it, was CHANGED by a ChangeEvent with detected_at strictly after the fact's valid_from — keyed on the fact and the later changes, so a further change asks again. Undated changes are counted in the evidence and never treated as later; undated facts are skipped. Neither judges whether a recorded cause was right: both report absence of a record (dec:report-dont-judge).","name":"A repair joined to no cause, and a recorded defect whose subject changed with nothing saying it was fixed, are noticed by the loop","provenance":"authored","status":"realized"}
